description: This file contains migration functions for updating configuration files and security-related command restrictions in a VSCode extension, including JSON to YAML migration and removal of insecure default commands.

methods.name: migrateSettings
methods.description: Main function to migrate old settings files to new formats and filenames, including special handling for custom_modes.json to YAML.

methods.name: migrateCustomModesToYaml
methods.description: Converts custom_modes.json to YAML format, preserving the original JSON file for rollback.

methods.name: migrateDefaultCommands
methods.description: Removes insecure default commands from allowed commands list to address security vulnerabilities.
